        Emulator setup

        Safe, automatic repair for supported Steam/GBE Fork games.

        Steam / GBE Fork
        • Automatically fix newly detected games
          Runs the safe Steam/GBE Fork repair once for a newly detected game. Disabled by default.
        • steam_settings data
          Simple uses AW Next's own fetch (anonymous). Advanced runs generate_emu_config for depot/language coverage.
        • Data source (Advanced)
          Anonymous mode already retrieves public DLC/depot data. Steam login is optional: it only adds private or hidden data (such as some depots, branches or languages). Use a THROWAWAY account only - never your main.
        Steam login (throwaway account only)
        Throwaway account

        Used only when "Data source" is set to Steam login. The password is stored encrypted on this PC and sent only to Steam by generate_emu_config. Steam Guard 2FA is prompted when needed. Leave empty to be asked each time.

        Advanced options
        • Auto-unpack SteamStub DRM
          Runs Steamless on the game exe before patching to strip Valve's SteamStub DRM (original kept as .steamstub.bak). No-op when there's no stub.
        • Steamless experimental
          Realigns sections during unpack for better compatibility with heavily-protected EXEs. Only matters when auto-unpack is on.
        • Auto-apply community fix (CrakFiles)
          On every fix, automatically downloads and applies a community fix from the CrakFiles list when the name matches with high confidence (pixeldrain links only; overwritten files are backed up). Off by default - enable it if you want AW to download and overwrite game files from a community source.
        • Steam API ownership-check bypass
          Off by default. Drops SteamAutoCrack's bypass proxy (winmm.dll) + a redirect config so games that re-check the original steam_api/exe after the DLL swap still launch and unlock. Downloads the proxy from its official release.
        • Check for GBE Fork updates
          Re-checks GitHub for the latest GBE Fork build before applying (downloads only if newer). Disable to always use the cached build.
        • GBE/Goldberg - download icons
          When enabled, any repair that writes steam_settings/achievements.json - automatic or from Game health - also downloads the achievement icons from the Steam CDN.
        Emulator DLL
        • Emulator DLL Checking…
          Import your own steam_api / steam_api64.dll to use it instead of the downloaded GBE Fork build, for every fix and automatic fix. The architecture you do not import keeps coming from the official build.
        Ubisoft / Uplay R1/R2

        Only compatible detected installations are changed. Existing files are backed up and the result is validated automatically.

        Emulator repair
        • Automatically fix newly detected games
          Automatically repairs newly detected Uplay R1/R2 games. Disabled by default.
        • Diagnostic logging
          Enable only while troubleshooting; it can create loader log files beside the game.
        Integrated repair package
        • Integrated repair package Checking…
          AW Next verifies its integrated repair files and automatically selects the architecture proved by each game.
        • Repair detected Uplay R1/R2 games
          Only compatible detected installations are changed. Existing files are backed up and the result is validated automatically.

                                Tips & tricks
                                  Setup & maintenance
                                  • Fix all detected games
                                    Run the matching Steam/GBE Fork or Ubisoft/Uplay R1/R2 repair on every compatible detected game with a known install folder.
                                  • Disable hardware acceleration
                                    Turn off GPU acceleration if the in-game overlay or window misbehaves. Requires a restart.
                                  • Clear caches
                                    Deletes re-downloadable caches: update files, Steam/Ubisoft schema & icon cache, and downloaded emulator-fix tools. Never touches your settings, saves, backups, or manually placed files.
                                  • Recheck achievement lists
                                    Checks Steam for achievements added by a game update since the last check. Runs automatically every 3 days; this forces it now.
                                    Goldberg / GBE Fork

                                    • Scan a game-library folder for Goldberg / GBE Fork installs and flag the ones missing their steam_settings/achievements.json schema. Use a game's right-click menu (Diagnose / Repair) to fix one.

                                          Preset designer

                                          •

                                          • Launch at startup
                                            Starts AW Next automatically with Windows, hidden in the tray.
                                          • Close to System Tray
                                            Keep the app running in the background for faster notifications startup.
                                          • Uninstall from the game list
                                            Adds Uninstall options to the right-click menu on game tiles (Steam uninstall, game uninstaller, or move folder to Recycle Bin).
                                          • Show Play button
                                            Show the Play button on game tiles. Turn it off if you launch your games from another program. The right-click Launch game entry stays available.
                                          • First-run guide
                                            Reopen the setup guide for profile, folders, sources, and notifications.
                                          Theme
                                          • Theme
                                            Color theme of the whole app and the in-game overlay (previews immediately, saved with OK).
                                          Theme files

                                          Export the theme you are using as a single .awtheme file, or import one somebody sent you. An imported theme carries its own images and behaves exactly like a built-in one.

                                          Custom theme

                                          Pick a color and, optionally, an image for each block. An image shows over the color (which becomes a light veil for readability). Everything previews live and saves with OK - the in-game overlay follows too.

                                          Controller
                                          • Control the in-game overlay with a controller
                                            Toggle and move the in-game overlay with a gamepad. Shortcuts and the button layout are configured below.
                                          • Control the app with a controller
                                            Navigate the AW Next window with a gamepad: library, game details, settings and searches.
                                          • Controller layout
                                            Choose the button names shown for controller shortcuts. Auto follows the connected controller when it can be identified.
                                          • Open/close overlay
                                            + +
                                            Buttons pressed together to open or close the in-game overlay.
                                          • Overlay control
                                            + +
                                            Toggles in-overlay navigation: focus ring, search and options.
                                          • Move & scroll
                                            + +
                                            Hold these buttons to move the overlay with the left stick and scroll with the right stick.
                                          • Focus overlay when it opens
                                            Give the overlay keyboard focus when it opens. Many games pause when they lose focus. Windows input APIs do not let a third-party app capture a controller exclusively, so the game may still see the buttons.
                                          • Send Escape to the game when opening with controller
                                            Send Escape to the game when you open the overlay with a controller, so many games pause or open their menu.
                                          • Controller backend
                                            Auto picks the best available input backend. Choose XInput for maximum compatibility, or GameInput on newer Windows builds.

                                            How it works
                                            
                  
                                            
                
                                            
                
                                            
                  
                                            
                    
                    Scan
                    Launcher, emulator and achievement-file locations are detected automatically - you review each one before the first scan.
                  
                                            
                  
                                            
                    
                    Watch
                    The background Watchdog spots the game when it launches, tracks playtime and watches its achievement files.
                  
                                            
                  
                                            
                    
                    Repair
                    For emulated Steam games, the right-click fix installs GBE Fork and writes the achievement schema and DLC data.
                  
                                            
                  
                                            
                    
                    In-game overlay
                    A small achievements panel you bring up over the game with a hotkey - Ctrl+Shift+K by default.
